description: A very LONG thin ribbon-like CUTLASSFISH facing RIGHT, metallic silver body bending gently in an S curve, small sharp-toothed closed jaw. Continuous intact body with THREE bold cyan-violet angular rift bands across flank, not detached pieces. Dorsal ridge forms a row of tiny crystal-blade triangles. Long tapering pointed tail at LEFT, no forked fish tail. Bright silver highlights and deep indigo shadows. Crisp original pixel shading, vivid colors, clear margins.
